title: Fallen Purple Sorceress
description: A young woman with white hair and purple eyes lies supine on a dark floor, wearing ornate white and purple traditional robes with armored gauntlets. Broken purple shards, a shattered purple chain, and crescent moon symbols are scattered around her body.
prompt: A young dark-skinned sorceress with long flowing white hair lies motionless on her back on a dark gray floor, wearing intricate white and purple East Asian inspired robes with silver details and armored gauntlets. Her eyes are open with a vacant expression. Shattered purple crystalline shards, broken purple chain links, and glowing purple crescent moons are scattered around her body. Dramatic lighting, highly detailed digital painting style.
